description: val5-fvs-04: the state an overflowing FVSCHEDULE leaves, and dynamic-array formulas. Blocks of four rows on P, run bottom to top: the overflow (in A, or inside the spilling formula in C), a spilling formula in C of the row above (it spills into D), and two `=2^1023` detectors in A; label in H. Where Excel calculates a spilling formula is not known, so sheet Drain (first sheet, calculated last) holds four more detectors. THIS FILL MAY BE REFUSED by the canary if a spilling formula runs after every other cell: keep the workbook then, as below. The spilling formulas are in the check list by their anchor cell only. One workbook per case, each its own session (rustsheet-oracle fill -b excel-graph). Raw values only. Precision!B2:B4 must be 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002 and C2:C4 -1, 0, 1. Do not add cells, observers or sheets: where each formula sits is the experiment. Predictions are hypotheses, NOT expected values. If the canary refuses a workbook, keep the downloaded bytes and report `rustsheet-eval snapshot` of them. Protocol and frozen predictions: docs/research/r8fvs-carried-overflow-state-2026-11-10.md.
